about.headline: the morning will come when the world is mine
about.bio: I'm a degenerate (trader) since 2017. My instincts tend to revolve around theta farming but I can take momentum tracks too. Historically I'm most successful in trading the VIX, with a high return in elections, and I've recently branched out to prediction markets with a large % of capital now that Trump has made doing basically anything legal. I dabbled in predictit before from 2017-2024, but the limits were very low so my 1000% return ultimately only produced something like 18k. I might increase my 16.7% of total capital in polymarket if I decide that I have more of an edge there than in traditional markets.

home.name: i am suzerain.
home.tag: i'm here to write the future.

log.body: Back from Europe. The AI trade continues to go parabolic and weigh on my portfolio, although I've fortunately taken a very shallow drawdown. My choice to play short puts instead of being long oil any other way has paid off — oil has sold off on jawboning and this current MOU rumor. I'd actually prefer the MOU to go through so I can go long without options, but we seem to be in a perpetual nothing-ever-happens state. Relatively satisfied with Polymarket performance, although I sold out of one oil bet for essentially breakeven after misreading that the Sunday globex session only applies to the next day's trading log.

Moved $100k from IBKR to Polymarket. I have some issues with the site but it seems like prediction market trading has potential to pay, especially since I can get paid passively as a liquidity provider. My macro views haven't changed, although I'm leaning more toward expressing my view by betting against any extended downside in oil via short puts, rather than trying to short SPX directly, which is extremely strong due to the AI trade.

Beginning of my logging. I've had some extremely garbage years from 2024 to 2025 and I've spent the past year trying to recover from that. First goal is 1m net liquidity. Right now I'm short the market, long a bit of AI, and long oil as macro expressions on the Iran war.
